name: diagnose-service-health
description: Diagnose orthodox-backend or omai service health using local health endpoints and journal hints. Advisory only.

deterministic_steps.action: Resolve service name to known health URL from service map
GET health endpoint on localhost or LAN host only
Summarize status, latency, and recent error patterns from response
Recommend operator next steps without executing service changes

model_advisory_steps: Correlate health failure with open tasks in brain memory
Check correction_memory for prior misdiagnoses of same service
verification_steps: No systemctl or restart commands in steps
RuleEngine classifyChange returns informational for read-only diagnose
